subject: Brightleaf: lightweight portal sync and minimal SIG import
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jared@brightleaf.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Rossi <security@brightleaf.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Minimal SIG import + portal onboarding

Hi Priya,

Quick note from Brightleaf — we're preparing to onboard to a vendor security portal and want to do a lightweight/surgical import of our SIG responses (not a full portal migration). The goals are: get Redwood's vendor profile live in the portal, upload a small set of authoritative evidence artifacts, and map the SIG fields that Redwood needs for our procurement review.

High level: can you confirm whether Redwood can accept our SIG export and perform a minimal import into Vendr or Whistic? We prefer Vendr for its ephemeral evidence handling but happy to follow your recommendation.

We have a recent SIG export attached. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jared
Buyer — Vendor Risk & Compliance
Brightleaf Health

[attachment: brightleaf_SIG_export_20260321.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Bloom <jared@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <security@brightleaf.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Minimal SIG import + portal onboarding

Hi Jared — thanks for sending the export and context. We can absolutely do a targeted import and keep the scope narrow. Proposed lightweight path below (aimed at a 5 business-day window from sign-off):

1) Intake & mapping (Day 1): Redwood reviews the XLSX and returns a one-page mapping (SIG question -> Redwood answer).
2) Minimal import (Day 2–3): Use Vendr's import API (preferred) or Whistic bulk Q&A to create the profile and attach 3–6 evidence items.
3) Evidence TTL & provenance (Day 3): Mark uploaded artifacts with a 90-day TTL and source notes; generate evidence manifest for Brightleaf procurement.
4) Validation & handoff (Day 4–5): Brightleaf confirms mapping; Redwood finishes API keys and access roles.

Open questions for you:
- Which portal do you want us to target (Vendr / Whistic / OneTrust)?
- Any controls you require us to make "authoritative" (e.g., encryption at rest proof, SOC 2 report)?
- Do you want evidence to be staged in your S3 bucket (presigned upload) or uploaded to the portal from Redwood's side?

I've looped in Mina (security) and Karthik (platform integrator) to confirm the technical approach. Attaching our intake checklist so Brightleaf can mark required artifacts.

Next step: reply with portal choice and whether procurement needs DocuSign before we start. If you approve the plan, we'll schedule the import and share a canary time-window for the evidence upload.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood_import_checklist.csv (CSV)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Bloom <jared@brightleaf.com>, Elena Rossi <security@brightleaf.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Minimal SIG import + portal onboarding — security clarifications

Thanks — quick security clarifications before we proceed:

- Authoritative artifacts: we should surface SOC 2 Type II (last 12 months) OR a signed bridge letter if your SOC2 is in progress. If neither is available, we'll flag the item as "self-attested" in the portal.
- Encryption evidence: a one-page KMS/tenant key doc or KMS ARN + rotation cadence screenshot is sufficient for our mapping.
- Sensitive fields: redact any PHI/PII from artifacts before upload. If you want Redwood to redact, confirm a redaction SLA.
- Portal preference: Vendr is preferred for ephemeral evidence (presigned S3 uploads + short TTL). Whistic works but requires a bulk Q&A path and manual proofs for some controls.

Technical note for Karthik: if Brightleaf wants the presigned S3 approach, we'll need a target bucket and a single-time presigned PUT for each artifact. We'll store a manifest with checksum and set evidence TTL at portal metadata.

I'll remain on the thread for verification. Priya — once Jared confirms portal choice and artifact set, Karthik and I will provide the final import playbook.

—Mina
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Minimal SIG import + portal onboarding — plan & timeline

Thanks for the quick responses, everyone. Jared — based on Brightleaf preference for ephemeral evidence and Mina's note, let's target Vendr and use presigned S3 uploads. Summary and next steps: 

- Scope: minimal SIG field mapping (priority list attached) + up to 6 evidence files (SOC2 summary or bridge letter, KMS screenshot, personnel screening policy, one network diagram, backup policy).
- Timeline: start on 2026-03-25 (canary import for 10 sample Q&A rows) and full import on 2026-03-26 if all green.
- Evidence handling: Brightleaf will provide a target S3 bucket and 6 presigned PUT URLs; Redwood will upload artifacts and publish a manifest with checksums and TTL=90 days.
- Roles: Karthik will handle API keys and the import job; Tessa will enable evidence rotation schedule and retention notes in the portal; Mina will validate control mappings post-import.

Please confirm two things so we can go ahead: 1) confirmation to target Vendr; 2) S3 bucket name and a contact for presigned URL handoff. If procurement needs DocuSign, copy procurement@brightleaf.com on that reply.

If you approve, I'll kick off the canary import tomorrow morning and post the Vendr import job link here.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this lightweight profile live.

Best,
Priya
